dateline: Hawthorne, CA / Boca Chica, TX — May 2002–Present
heroHeadline: SpaceX Announces 5-for-1 Pre-IPO Stock Split (May 16) as CRS-34 Dragon Flies to ISS; IFT-12 Starship Block 3 T-3 Days to Launch
heroSubtitle: 8,776 days of SpaceX milestones — On May 16, 2026, SpaceX announced a 5-for-1 pre-IPO stock split adjusting the fair market value per share from $526.59 to ~$105.32, with split processing expected May 18–22 ahead of the public S-1 filing (open May 15–22), management roadshow (week of June 8), and IPO pricing target (June 18–30) on Nasdaq at $1.75T–$2T+ valuation. The split is designed to maximize retail participation in the company's planned 30% retail allocation. Meanwhile, CRS-34 Cargo Dragon (Dragon C209, launched May 15 at 6:05 p.m. EDT) is en route to the ISS after Falcon 9 booster B1096 made SpaceX's 611th cumulative booster recovery landing at LZ-40 — Dragon docking with ISS Harmony targeting 7:05 a.m. EDT on May 17. Starship IFT-12 Block 3 is T-3 days from its NET May 19 launch window (5:30 p.m. CDT, OLP-2, Starbase) with Ship 39 + Booster 19 fully stacked and all vehicle checkout milestones on schedule. SpaceX: 58 orbital missions in 2026, 611 total booster recoveries, 11 Starship integrated flight tests completed, 10,374+ Starlink satellites in orbit, 10M+ subscribers.
